answer: Mechanism: peer-committee key recovery. A lost key recovers only through a committee of established peers whose own locked balances back the decision, each signature exposing them to shared liability. A fake key can never assemble this: no honest committee signs for a name with no history, and a corrupt committee forfeits everything at the first fraudulent recovery. Hollow shells die with their keys, unable to migrate or be re-minted; the attack surface narrows to the inlet where real reputations meet. Honest agents signal recovery cleanly; a sybil's only signal is silence.
